key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 08!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 08!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説08を手に入れた!

key: Info on Swamp Field now available!
en: Info on Swamp Field now available!
ja: スワンプフィールドの情報が閲覧できるようになった!

key: Huh? Could it be that you've already finished?
en: Huh? Could it be that you've already finished?
ja: あら? もしかしてもう終わったんですか?

key: Oh, thank heavens.
en: Oh, thank heavens.
ja: ああ、良かった。

key: I'm surprised you were able to deal with Amoongus of that level--
en: I'm surprised you were able to deal with Amoongus of that level--
ja: あのレベルのモロバレルを相手にできたなんて、驚きました――

key: Uh! Not that I thought I was putting you into any risk or anything.
en: Uh! Not that I thought I was putting you into any risk or anything.
ja: あ! 別に危険な目に遭わせるつもりだったわけじゃ……

key: Regardless! Why don't you take this for your trouble?
en: Regardless! Why don't you take this for your trouble?
ja: とにかく! お礼にこれを受け取ってください。

key: Hopefully it can keep you safe during your travels.
en: Hopefully it can keep you safe during your travels.
ja: 旅の道中、あなたを守ってくれるといいのですが。

key: I think there's about \v[0062] left.
en: I think there's about \v[0062] left.
ja: 残りはあと\v[0062]くらいだと思います。

key: Geez, no matter how many of these Foongus we clear out, they just keep coming back...
en: Geez, no matter how many of these Foongus we clear out, they just keep coming back...
ja: まったく、タマゲタケをいくら駆除しても、次から次へと湧いてくるんだから……

key: Their prevalance is choking out other species.
en: Their prevalance is choking out other species.
ja: 数が多すぎて、他の種を締め出してしまっているんです。

key: If you don't mind clearing all of the ones you see around here, I'd appreciate it.
en: If you don't mind clearing all of the ones you see around here, I'd appreciate it.
ja: この辺りで見かけるものを全部駆除してもらえたら助かります。

key: Happy travels, kind stranger. If you're ever in the area, drop by the Azurine Center!
en: Happy travels, kind stranger. If you're ever in the area, drop by the Azurine Center!
ja: 旅の無事を祈ります、親切な旅の方。この辺りに来ることがあれば、アズリンセンターにも寄ってくださいね!

key: The wild Heracross and Pinsir we worked on in the Aventurine Nature Center seem to get along much better here than in those woods.
en: The wild Heracross and Pinsir we worked on in the Aventurine Nature Center seem to get along much better here than in those woods.
ja: アベンチュリンネイチャーセンターで世話をしていた野生のヘラクロスとカイロスは、あの森にいたときより、ここのほうがずっと仲良くやっているみたい。

key: Maybe it's because they don't have to compete over the honey?
en: Maybe it's because they don't have to compete over the honey?
ja: 蜜を取り合わなくて済むからかしら?

key: Awh, lord, I'm really in a jam.
en: Awh, lord, I'm really in a jam.
ja: ああもう、本当に困ったことになったわ。

key: I'm one 'Mon shy on my reintroduction quota for the term.
en: I'm one 'Mon shy on my reintroduction quota for the term.
ja: 今期の再導入ノルマが、あと1匹足りないの。

key: Say, do you happen to have a Carnivine?
en: Say, do you happen to have a Carnivine?
ja: ねえ、もしかしてマスキッパを持っていたりしない?

key: If you could shore me up, I'd be much obliged.
en: If you could shore me up, I'd be much obliged.
ja: 都合をつけてくれたら、すごく助かるんだけど。

key: I have a spare Egg I could give you in return.
en: I have a spare Egg I could give you in return.
ja: お礼に、余っているタマゴをあげられるわ。

key: We were going to reintroduce that species to Reborn, but our program schedule was changed when this place opened, so now it's extraneous.
en: We were going to reintroduce that species to Reborn, but our program schedule was changed when this place opened, so now it's extraneous.
ja: その種をリボーンに再導入する予定だったんだけど、ここが開設されてプログラムの予定が変わって、今は余ってしまっているの。

key: Ah, Trainer, you wouldn't happen to have a Carnivine, would you?
en: Ah, Trainer, you wouldn't happen to have a Carnivine, would you?
ja: あ、トレーナーさん、もしかしてマスキッパを持っていたりしませんか?

key: Ah, it was worth a shot.
en: Ah, it was worth a shot.
ja: ああ、聞くだけ聞いてみたけど。

key: You got one?!
en: You got one?!
ja: 持ってるの?!

key: Oh, this is such a relief. Thank you very much.
en: Oh, this is such a relief. Thank you very much.
ja: ああ、本当に助かるわ。ありがとう。

key: Here.
en: Here.
ja: はい、どうぞ。

key: \PN traded Carnivine for an egg!
en: \PN traded Carnivine for an egg!
ja: \PNはマスキッパをタマゴと交換した!

key: Great! You really saved my neck!
en: Great! You really saved my neck!
ja: やった! 本当に助かったわ!

key: Stay safe, Trainer.
en: Stay safe, Trainer.
ja: 気をつけてね、トレーナーさん。

key: Welcome, friend.
en: Welcome, friend.
ja: ようこそ、旅の方。

key: You're a Trainer, are you not?
en: You're a Trainer, are you not?
ja: あなた、トレーナーですよね?

key: Could I interest you in taking this Pokémon off of our hands?
en: Could I interest you in taking this Pokémon off of our hands?
ja: このポケモンを引き取ってもらえないかしら?

key: We found this Chikorita locked in the basement of the old building when we started making plans to rebuild.
en: We found this Chikorita locked in the basement of the old building when we started making plans to rebuild.
ja: 再建の計画を始めたとき、古い建物の地下室に閉じ込められていたこのチコリータを見つけたの。

key: The poor thing showed signs of some past abuse, so I want to make sure it goes to a good Trainer.
en: The poor thing showed signs of some past abuse, so I want to make sure it goes to a good Trainer.
ja: かわいそうに、過去に虐待されていた形跡があって、ちゃんとした良いトレーナーの元に行かせてあげたいの。

key: We would keep it here, but it seems to be frightened of many of the other Pokémon we work with.
en: We would keep it here, but it seems to be frightened of many of the other Pokémon we work with.
ja: ここに置いておきたいところだけど、ここで世話をしている他のポケモンの多くを怖がっているみたいで。

key: Would you be willing to look after it?
en: Would you be willing to look after it?
ja: 面倒を見てもらえないかしら?

key: Wonderful. That's a relief.
en: Wonderful. That's a relief.
ja: よかった。ほっとしたわ。

key: Please take good care of Chikorita.
en: Please take good care of Chikorita.
ja: チコリータのこと、よろしくお願いね。

key: I see. That's too bad.
en: I see. That's too bad.
ja: そう。残念だわ。

key: No problem though. I'm sure someone will come by for it eventually.
en: No problem though. I'm sure someone will come by for it eventually.
ja: でも大丈夫。いつか誰かが引き取りに来てくれるはずだから。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
